name: playwright
description: Drive a real Chromium browser: navigate, click, type, snapshot the accessibility tree, screenshot, and read network requests.

name: fs
description: Read, write, and list files under the current working directory.

name: sheets
description: Google Sheets over your Google account: list spreadsheets, describe a workbook's tabs and sizes, read a range (raw rows or header-keyed alists), overwrite a range, append rows, clear a range, add a tab, create a spreadsheet. (load-mcp "sheets") starts the server if it is not already up, then returns an authorization link; approve it and it is captured for you, then load again. (login "sheets") asks for the link on its own and (logout "sheets") forgets the account.

name: ocr
description: Read a scanned PDF or image with Mistral OCR and get its text back as Markdown, one entry per page, tables included. Takes a public URL or a local file path. Its Mistral key comes from Infisical at /mcps/mistral.

name: linear
description: Linear issue tracker over OAuth: search/list/create issues, projects, comments. First (load-mcp "linear") returns an authorization link; approve it, run (mcp-authorize "linear" "<code>"), then load again.

name: posthog
description: PostHog product analytics over OAuth: query insights, dashboards, feature flags, experiments, error tracking, events, and SQL. First (load-mcp "posthog") returns an authorization link; approve it, run (mcp-authorize "posthog" "<code>"), then load again. Edit `scopes` to grant more.
